map_title: A New and Correct Map of the Province of North Carolina
creator: Edward Moseley
digital_reproduction_note: ECU digitization date not specified in item catalog. This is a scan of the original print, not the distinct 1737 Cowley map or its 2008 reproduction.
resolution_decision: Native full/full JPEG endpoint returned HTTP 504 twice. 10000-wide image succeeded; all image areas preserved at highest practical successful resolution. Source JPEG is institutional compression; downstream COG compression is lossless.
institution: East Carolina University, J. Y. Joyner Library, East Carolina Manuscript Collection
attribution: A New and Correct Map of the Province of North Carolina (Moseley Map) (#MC0017), East Carolina Manuscript Collection, J. Y. Joyner Library, East Carolina University, Greenville, North Carolina, USA.
rights_statement: Finding aid: Access: No restrictions. Copyright notice says literary rights to specific documents are retained by authors or descendants in accordance with US copyright law. Item page has a general ECU website copyright footer but no item-specific reuse license located; retain institutional attribution. No inference of a specific digital-image license.
edition_verification: Cartouche visibly reads Edward Moseley and 1733; preserved title crop. Inset titles include Port Brunswick/Cape Fear, Port Beaufort/Topsail, Ocacock. Distinct MC0035 1737/2008 record excluded.
physical_condition: Visible panel/scan seams, folds and discoloration across image; lower inset strip excluded conservatively. No seam correction or label restoration.
